note_tweet.text:
Beloved actor, radio performer, and voice actor Edson Silva has passed away today at the age of 95, leaving behind a career spanning decades of theater, television, and Portuguese-language dubbing.

Silva lent his voice to an incredible range of characters, including Hawkman, Solomon Grundy, Klaw. He also voiced several beloved characters in the Scooby-Doo franchise for Brazilian audiences.

His career belonged to an era when voice actors could become inseparable from beloved characters while remaining largely unknown to the audiences who grew up hearing their voices.

Edson Silva may have worked behind the microphone, but his voice found its way into generations of homes, memories, and childhoods.

Rest in paradise, Edson Silva. 🤍
